scope: Same fixed segment, model proxies only; not measured physical passage clearance
selectionRule: Original frame39 in previously fixed disputed western ROI; original frame38→40 camera displacement defines local aisle tangent. Chosen before reference-column results; not optimized for width. Exact photo gap identity unverified.
crossSectionCellTraversal: exact intersections with source raster edges; interval midpoint identifies cell; no interpolated geometry
limits: Reference values are vertex-column summaries, not triangle intersection or continuous-volume clearance.
No vertices does not establish observed free space; reference cleaned/completed and different capture time.
Global floor registration can put floor vertices in low obstacle band.
No chair/table/wall surfaces are semantically identified.
Camera centre and short chronological tangent need not equal body centre or aisle axis.
A single fixed cross-section does not establish a traversable corridor or loop.
Section clipped run lengths are lower bounds within the fixed segment, not complete gap widths.
